verdict.rationale: Kimi documents an official desktop app, Kimi Code Desktop, which opens local project folders and lets the agent read and edit files and run commands. That covers only the 'official desktop app' part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows OS-level global shortcuts or reading what is on the user's screen, and the browser extension is a separate surface that does not count. Missing for 10: OS-level/global keyboard shortcuts, screen-content access or screen capture, a general-purpose desktop assistant beyond the coding app, independent corroboration.
